actions.description: Pause the MuJoCo ROS simulator with the acknowledged set_pause service
actions.name: pause

outputs.description: True once the SetPause response reports success=true
outputs.name: acknowledged

facts.text: RosAPI::SetupServices advertises the relative set_pause service through the node's private node handle.
RosAPI::SetPauseCB takes a mujoco_ros_msgs::SetPause request and response and sets response.success from TogglePaused(req.paused, req.admin_hash).
SetPause.srv declares request fields bool paused and string admin_hash and response field bool success.
MujocoEnv::TogglePaused refuses a paused=true request when VerifyAdminHash fails, before calling SetPaused, and returns false.
MujocoEnv::VerifyAdminHash compares the supplied hash with settings_.admin_hash only when eval_mode is set; outside eval mode it returns true.
SimulationControlState::SetPaused stores running_ = !paused and notifies the physics condition.
The physics loop calls SimPausedPhysics while the control snapshot is not running and SimUnpausedPhysics otherwise.
SimPausedPhysics executes requested manual steps through WrappedStep; without a pending step it runs mj_forward and publishes simulation time.
MujocoEnv::GetSimInfo reports paused as the negation of the control snapshot's running flag.
RosAPI::SetupServices advertises the relative get_sim_info service through the node's private node handle.
RosAPI::GetSimInfoCB takes a mujoco_ros_msgs::GetSimInfo request and response, calls MujocoEnv::GetSimInfo and assigns res.state.paused.
GetSimInfo.srv has an empty request and response field mujoco_ros_msgs/SimInfo state.
The ROS 1 MujocoEnv constructor creates the private node handle "~" and passes it to RosAPI, so relative service names resolve under the node's private namespace.
The pinned launch file starts the mujoco_node executable as a node named mujoco_server; the node tag carries no ns attribute.

determinism.notes: Event-driven recording fake with no physics step or pacing; placeholder paused state does not establish a trajectory or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport: it runs no MuJoCo engine, physics stepping, contacts, sensors, renderer, ROS node or simulator process, and has no wall-clock pacing
the fake answers only the two declared services and omits the rest of the SimInfo response; it reports only state.paused, which is the field this package consumes
the paused flag is placeholder test state; holding it does not prove that an upstream simulator was running or that its physics loop paused
no live ROS graph, rosbridge connection, simulator execution or hardware validation has run; the evidence remains contract_checked
the empty admin_hash request assumes an unauthenticated deployment outside eval mode; an eval-mode deployment may reject it with success=false
pause is the simulator stop, not a physical emergency stop, and it makes no claim about robot velocities or a hardware safe state
pause does not cancel pending or external manual steps; the paused branch can still advance physics, and the fake does not model that step queue
resume, model reload, world step, gravity, robot actuation and shutdown are not exposed

measures.description: Read the simulator's paused flag from the acknowledged get_sim_info service
measures.name: get_sim_info

safe_state.description: Continuous simulation run is disabled (running=false). The paused branch can still execute pending or externally requested manual steps; this is not proof of quiescent physics, a frozen clock or a physical emergency stop.
